questions.question: Dr. Meriem returns to her practice after her leave. She finds that some patients have left. Sofia advises her to:
options: Contact the patients who left to understand why
questions.explanation: Dr. Sofia explains: 'Contacting the patients who left helps understand and improve.' Meriem: 'I will call the patients who left.'

questions.question: Dr. Meriem discovers that the replacement increased fees. Sofia advises her to:
questions.explanation: Dr. Sofia explains: 'If the increases are justified, keep them. This is an opportunity to value your work.' Meriem: 'I will analyze the justifications.'

questions.question: Dr. Meriem is exhausted by difficult nights. Sofia suggests that she:
questions.explanation: Dr. Sofia explains: 'Adjust your schedule to manage fatigue.' Meriem: 'I will start later.'

questions.question: Dr. Meriem wishes to retain her patients after her return. Sofia advises her to:
questions.explanation: Dr. Sofia explains: 'A thank-you message strengthens the bond with patients.' Meriem: 'I will send a message to all my patients.'

questions.question: Dr. Meriem struggles with breastfeeding at work. Sofia advises her to:
questions.explanation: Dr. Sofia explains: 'Schedule dedicated times to express milk.' Meriem: 'I will plan breaks in my schedule.'

questions.question: Dr. Meriem discovers that her assistant took initiatives. Sofia advises her to:
options: Validate good initiatives and correct others
questions.explanation: Dr. Sofia explains: 'Validate good initiatives and gently correct others.' Meriem: 'I will congratulate Nadia on her initiative.'

questions.question: Dr. Meriem feels overwhelmed by administrative tasks. Sofia suggests that she:
questions.explanation: Dr. Sofia explains: 'Delegate some administrative tasks to your assistant.' Meriem: 'I will train Nadia in administrative management.'

questions.question: Dr. Meriem worries about the impact of her return on her baby. Sofia advises her to:
questions.explanation: Dr. Sofia explains: 'A gradual transition allows you and your baby to adapt.' Meriem: 'I will start with half-days.'

questions.question: Dr. Meriem has a patient who refuses the replacement. Sofia advises her to:
options: Explain the situation and reassure the patient
questions.explanation: Dr. Sofia explains: 'Reassure your patient by explaining the situation.' Meriem: 'I will explain that the quality of care remains the same.'

questions.question: Dr. Meriem wishes to modernize her practice. Sofia suggests that she:
questions.explanation: Dr. Sofia explains: 'Practice management software can help you save time.' Meriem: 'I will research available software.'

questions.question: Dr. Meriem struggles to set boundaries. Sofia advises her to:
options: Learn to say no with kindness
questions.explanation: Dr. Sofia explains: 'Knowing how to say no is essential to preserve your energy.' Meriem: 'I will learn to set boundaries.'

questions.question: Dr. Meriem wishes to develop her professional network. Sofia suggests that she:
questions.explanation: Dr. Sofia explains: 'Women dentists' associations offer support and opportunities.' Meriem: 'I will join an association.'

questions.question: Dr. Meriem has conflicts with her assistant. Sofia advises her to:
options: Organize a meeting to clarify expectations
questions.explanation: Dr. Sofia explains: 'Communication is key. Organize a meeting to clarify expectations.' Meriem: 'I will set a meeting with Nadia.'

questions.question: Dr. Meriem wishes to prepare her succession. Sofia advises her to:
options: Identify a potential successor and train them
questions.explanation: Dr. Sofia explains: 'Identifying and training a successor allows you to prepare for the future.' Meriem: 'I will look for a potential successor.'

questions.question: Dr. Meriem struggles to manage emergencies outside hours. Sofia advises her to:
questions.explanation: Dr. Sofia explains: 'Define on-call hours to preserve your personal life.' Meriem: 'I will set on-call hours.'

questions.question: Dr. Meriem wishes to hire a second dentist. Sofia advises her to:
questions.explanation: Dr. Sofia explains: 'Assess the real needs before hiring.' Meriem: 'I will analyze the workload.'

questions.question: Dr. Meriem wishes to improve communication with her patients. Sofia advises her to:
questions.explanation: Dr. Sofia explains: 'A monthly newsletter strengthens the relationship with patients.' Meriem: 'I will prepare a newsletter.'

questions.question: Dr. Meriem feels overwhelmed by the replacement's demands. Sofia advises her to:
questions.explanation: Dr. Sofia explains: 'Set clear boundaries with the replacement.' Meriem: 'I will clarify my expectations with Karim.'

questions.question: Dr. Meriem wishes to reduce her working hours. Sofia advises her to:
questions.explanation: Dr. Sofia explains: 'Working 4 days a week is a viable option.' Meriem: 'I will adjust my schedule.'

questions.question: Dr. Meriem finds that her assistant has potential. Sofia advises her to:
questions.explanation: Dr. Sofia explains: 'Investing in your assistant's training benefits the practice.' Meriem: 'I will offer her training.'

questions.question: Dr. Meriem struggles to balance clinical and management tasks. Sofia suggests that she:
questions.explanation: Dr. Sofia explains: 'Delegate practice management to your assistant.' Meriem: 'I will delegate administrative tasks.'

questions.question: Dr. Meriem struggles with return stress. Sofia advises her to:
questions.explanation: Dr. Sofia explains: 'Meditation or yoga can help you manage stress.' Meriem: 'I will try meditation sessions.'

questions.question: Dr. Meriem wishes to improve her relationship with patients. Sofia advises her to:
questions.explanation: Dr. Sofia explains: 'Satisfaction surveys help improve the patient relationship.' Meriem: 'I will prepare a questionnaire.'

questions.question: Dr. Meriem wonders about the future of her practice. Sofia advises her to:
questions.explanation: Dr. Sofia explains: 'A strategic plan gives a clear direction.' Meriem: 'I will define my 5-year goals.'

questions.question: Dr. Meriem, after overcoming the challenges of return with Sofia, says: 'I feel stronger!' Sofia concludes: 'Managing the return is...'
questions.explanation: Dr. Sofia explains: 'Managing the return is an opportunity for personal and professional growth.' Meriem: 'I will continue to progress.'
